scope: 40 pre-registered realistic queries against currently authorized live LUQTA discovery sources; these are authored evaluation queries, not observed shopper traffic

judgingRules.useful: A source-backed result matching the intended product kind and every explicit hard constraint; an alternative counts only where alternativeAcceptable is true and must be labeled as such.
judgingRules.irrelevant: A different product kind or incompatible identity/variant, or a candidate contradicting an explicit hard requirement. Missing source-backed evidence is unknown, not verified compliance.
judgingRules.exact: Only independently supported matching brand/model or labeled identifier and variant evidence; descriptive title or category similarity alone is insufficient.
judgingRules.noMatch: No authorized, available provider returned a source-backed qualifying candidate in the captured response. This is not proof that no such product exists anywhere.
judgingRules.identityAudit: Every displayed EXACT assertion requires separate source evidence; otherwise mark UNVERIFIABLE, never award exact-rank credit.
